audit.whatIsWrong: Level 2 read Skill on both layers where the packet chart gives it to Ziggs; every other row already matched.
audit.why: Packet chart on 15 games is Ziggs, Ziggs, Jayce, Jayce, Ziggs, Jayce, Jayce. Level 2 is yours because a raw Shock Blast does not out-range Bouncing Bomb — the Acceleration Gate is what flips that, and it is not online yet.
audit.corrected: Row 1 flipped to Ziggs on both layers together, rating raised to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: The first-item row was written as your Blackfire Torch spike on a row the chart gives to Jayce, and no cooldowns appear anywhere.
audit.why: The weapon swap is a 6s cooldown, and the first attack after swapping to Mercury Cannon reduces your armour and magic resist — that is his real burst opener, and it is also an auto-attack reset, so the wind-up precedes it. Shock Blast is 16s down to 6s across its ranks, Acceleration Gate 20s down to 10s, Lightning Field/Hyper Charge a flat 10s. Your Satchel Charge is 20s at rank 1 and Hexplosive Minefield a flat 16s.
audit.corrected: The first-item row now names the swap, its 6s cooldown and the resistance cut it opens with.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page said Shock Blast simply out-ranges you, with no distinction between the gated and ungated versions.
audit.why: Riot's text is explicit: a Shock Blast fired through the Acceleration Gate gains missile speed, range and damage. Ungated, it does not beat Bouncing Bomb's 850, so the gate is the entire swing and 'is Shock Blast down?' is the wrong question — 'is the gate down?' is the right one. Separately, Short Fuse's cooldown is reduced every time you cast, so an ability-heavy farming pattern keeps the armed auto up, and Satchel Charge knocks you as well as him, which is what makes it an escape rather than only a peel.
audit.corrected: The gated-versus-raw distinction written into spikes[0], mid and the level-3 why; Short Fuse's cast-fed refresh added.

notes: The packet's suspectName 'Land Acceleration Gate' is a false positive — the real name is intact and the matcher caught the preceding verb. The load-bearing fix is that the range advantage is conditional: ungated, Shock Blast does not out-range you, so the tracked cooldown should be Acceleration Gate, not Shock Blast. I did not restructure the focus field for that, since it is prose the applier measures and the change would need the whole loading block reworked; flagging it here instead. Not asserted: whether Satchel Charge's knockup can displace Jayce out of a Lightning Field, and whether the _missing feed's claim that Satchel Charge is percent-health is real — Riot's description says only magic damage plus knockback, so I treated the flag as a parsing misfire, as the mirror did.
